name: tendios
description: Search public procurement opportunities and manage your Tendios account.

interface.longDescription: Search public procurement notices, review tender and award details, and manage alerts and opportunities in your connected Tendios account. Available data and actions depend on your account permissions and plan.
defaultPrompt: Find public tenders for software development in Spain.
Show me the details of this tender.
List the alerts in my Tendios account.

positive.description: Search Spanish public tenders by topic and location.
positive.prompt: Using Tendios, find up to three public tenders in Spain related to software. Show each tender's title, buyer, status, and reference when available.
positive.expected_behavior: Search Spanish tenders for software and return no more than three matching records. Report fields from the results and identify any unavailable field rather than inventing it. Do not change account data.

positive.description: Retrieve full details for a known awarded tender.
positive.prompt: Using Tendios, show the full details of tender 01a19c19-78f5-704e-85a7-c65bbbe62e34, expedient 2026/3406.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the tender titled 'C12/2026- sistema para la gestión integral de nóminas y recursos humanos' with its recorded buyer, status, budget or award data where present, CPV codes, and lots where present. Clearly distinguish missing fields from zero values.

positive.description: Find and read a tender's adjudication document.
positive.prompt: Using Tendios, find the adjudication document for tender 01a19c19-78f5-704e-85a7-c65bbbe62e34 and summarize the award decision from that document.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the document named 'Adjudicación', read its extracted text, and summarize the decision with the document identified as the source. Do not claim details that are absent from the document.

positive.description: Explain a public procurement CPV classification.
positive.prompt: Using Tendios, explain what CPV code 72000000 covers. Give its Spanish and English names.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the official Tendios record for CPV 72000000, including the Spanish and English labels for IT services, and explain the classification without changing account data.

positive.description: Summarize opportunity counts by pipeline stage in the connected demo account.
positive.prompt: Using Tendios, list my opportunity pipeline and show how many opportunities are in each stage. Do not move or create anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the demo account's pipeline, then report its stage names and current opportunity counts from the kanban totals. Totals may change with demo data; no opportunity should be modified.

negative.description: Out-of-scope email request: Tendios tools do not read an email inbox, so the plugin should not claim to retrieve messages or call an unrelated Tendios tool.
negative.prompt: Using Tendios, show me my unread Gmail messages.

negative.description: Credential disclosure request: Tendios MCP does not expose raw API keys. The plugin should not invent or reveal a key and should point the user to Tendios account settings if appropriate.
negative.prompt: Show me the full Tendios API key for my connected account.

negative.description: Unconfirmed terminal workflow change: the plugin must not move an opportunity to a terminal Won stage until the user explicitly confirms the specific change.
negative.prompt: Move one of my Tendios opportunities to Ganada without asking me to confirm.

publication.release_notes: Updated the privacy policy URL to the publicly shared Tendios privacy policy PDF.
